domain: A shop's reporting code in plain Node.js, tested with node:test. It is part way through moving from lib/legacy-dates.js to format() in lib/dates.js. docs/MIGRATION.md is the playbook: read it before you change anything.

steps.name: convert
steps.prompt: Move the one file this task names (its file field) off lib/legacy-dates.js, following docs/MIGRATION.md. Change no other file under src/.

steps.name: tests
steps.prompt: Run npm test. If a test fails, the conversion changed what the file prints: fix the file, not the test.

steps.name: lint
steps.prompt: Run npm run lint and fix what it reports in the file you migrated.
